Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Repo version: tomlkit 0.13.0. Reproduction test file: tests/test_real_issues_411_377_381.py::test_issue_381_parse_aot_without_ending_newline_roundtrip

import tomlkit
from tomlkit import dumps
from tomlkit.items import Table


def test_issue_411_dump_nested_dotted_table():
    # https://github.com/python-poetry/tomlkit/issues/411
    # dumps() of a sub-table loses one nesting level.
    a = tomlkit.parse("a.b.c.d='e'")["a"]
    assert a == {"b": {"c": {"d": "e"}}}
    assert dumps(a) == "b.c.d='e'"


def test_issue_411_dump_nested_dotted_table_two_levels():
    doc = tomlkit.parse("a.b.c = 1\na.b.d = 2\n")
    sub = doc["a"]["b"]
    assert sub == {"c": 1, "d": 2}
    out = dumps(sub)
    assert out == "c = 1\nd = 2\n"


def test_issue_411_dumps_accepts_table_instance():
    # dumps() should accept a Table/InlineTable directly without
    # re-wrapping it into a plain dict (which loses style and nesting).
    doc = tomlkit.parse("[a]\nb = 1\n")
    table = doc["a"]
    assert isinstance(table, Table)
    assert dumps(table) == "b = 1\n"


def test_issue_377_no_empty_parent_header_for_super_table():
    # https://github.com/python-poetry/tomlkit/issues/377
    # Adding a second sub-table should not produce an empty parent header.
    doc = tomlkit.document()

    def add_table(parent, name):
        parent.add(name, tomlkit.table())
        return parent[name]

    root = add_table(doc, "root")
    add_table(root, "first")
    add_table(root, "second")

    out = dumps(doc)
    assert "[root]\n" not in out
    assert "[root.first]" in out
    assert "[root.second]" in out


def test_issue_381_parse_aot_without_ending_newline_roundtrip():
    # https://github.com/python-poetry/tomlkit/issues/381
    # Dumping a parsed doc whose last AOT entry lacks a trailing newline
    # must not corrupt the output.
    content = (
        '[[products]]\nname = "Hammer"\n\n[foo]\n\n[bar]\n\n[[products]]\nname = "Nail"'
    )
    doc = tomlkit.parse(content)
    out = doc.as_string()
    # The dumped output must still be parseable and preserve the data.
    reparsed = tomlkit.parse(out)
    assert reparsed == doc
    assert reparsed["products"] == [{"name": "Hammer"}, {"name": "Nail"}]
    assert reparsed["foo"] == {}
    assert reparsed["bar"] == {}
"
  }
}

state_snapshot.issue_summary:
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Repo version: tomlkit 0.13.0. Reproduction test file: tests/test_real_issues_411_377_381.py::test_issue_381_parse_aot_without_ending_newline_roundtrip

Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Repo version: tomlkit 0.13.0. Reproduction test file: tests/test_real_issues_411_377_381.py::test_issue_381_parse_aot_without_ending_newline_roundtrip

Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Repo version: tomlkit 0.13.0. Reproduction test file: tests/test_real_issues_411_377_381.py::test_issue_381_parse_aot_without_ending_newline_roundtrip

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

state_snapshot.issue_summary:
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Repo version: tomlkit 0.13.0. Reproduction test file: tests/test_real_issues_411_377_381.py::test_issue_381_parse_aot_without_ending_newline_roundtrip

state_snapshot.issue_summary:
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Repo version: tomlkit 0.13.0. Reproduction test file: tests/test_real_issues_411_377_381.py::test_issue_381_parse_aot_without_ending_newline_roundtrip

Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

2. 然后调用 `_parse_aot`。它向前查看下一个表 —— `[foo]`，它不是 `[[products]]`，所以 AOT 只有一个元素。

3. 然后解析器继续处理 `[foo]`。`_parse_table` 被调用。`indent = ""`。解析键 `foo`。`_parse_comment_trail()` 消耗了 `\n\n`。所以 `trail = "\n\n"`。`[foo]` 没有子项。

4. 然后是 `[bar]`。类似地，`trail = "\n\n"`。

5. 然后是第二个 `[[products]]`。`_parse_table` 被调用。`indent = ""`。解析键 `products`。`is_aot=True`。`_parse_comment_trail()` —— 在 `]]` 之后，下一个字符是 `\n`。它消耗了 `\n`。然后它尝试解析 trail —— 但在 `\n` 之后，下一个字符是 `n`（`name` 中的 n），它不是空格。所以 `trail = "\n"`。然后它解析 `name = "Nail"`。`name` 的 KV 对 —— `_parse_comment_trail()`。在 `"Nail"` 之后，我们处于 EOF。所以 `trail = ""`。

6. 然后再次调用 `_parse_aot`。向前查看 —— EOF，所以 AOT 只有一个元素。

7. 在顶层 `parse` 中，`body.append(key, value)` 被调用，其中 `value` 是新的单元素 AOT。由于 `products` 已经作为 AOT 存在，它进入第 269 行的分支：
```python
for table in item.body:
    current.append(table)
```

所以 `current.append(table)` 调用了 `AoT.insert(1, table)`。在 `insert` 中，`self._parsed` 为 `True`（因为 AoT 是用 `parsed=True` 创建的）。所以跳过了换行符处理块。该表被直接插入了。

现在问题很清楚了。第二个 `[[products]]` 表的 trail 是 `"\n"`（来自 `]]` 之后的 `_parse_comment_trail`）。但是 `name = "Nail"` KV 对的 trail 是 `""`（EOF，没有尾随换行符）。所以当 AoT 的 `as_string` 被调用时，它生成：
```
[[products]]\nname = "Hammer"\n\n[[products]]\nname = "Nail"
```

`name = "Nail"` 之后没有尾随换行符。然后当容器渲染 `[foo]` 和 `[bar]` 表时，它们被追加在后面……等等，实际上顺序很重要。

让我重新检查一下。容器主体（container body）的顺序是：`products`（AoT），`foo`（Table），`bar`（Table）。当第二个 `[[products]]` 被追加到现有的 AoT 时，AoT 现在有 2 个元素。但容器主体仍然有 `products`、`foo`、`bar` 的顺序。

所以 `as_string` 生成：
- `_render_aot(products)` → `[[products]]\nname = "Hammer"\n\n[[products]]\nname = "Nail"`（没有尾随换行符）
- `_render_table(foo)` → `[foo]\n\n`（带有 trail）
- `_render_table(bar)` → `[bar]\n\n`

等等，但是 `[foo]` 的缩进是 `""`。所以输出是：
```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]

```

`[foo]` 被粘在了 `name = "Nail"` 后面，因为 AoT 输出没有以换行符结尾，而 `[foo]` 表的缩进是 `""`。

现在让我看看 `_render_table` 是如何处理缩进的。查看第 496-518 行，当表不是超级表（super table）时，它会使用 `table.trivia.indent`。对于 `[foo]`，缩进是 `""`。

修复方法应该在 AoT 的 `as_string` 或 `_render_aot` 中 —— 确保最后一个表的输出以换行符结尾。但等等，让我看看 `_render_table` 是如何处理类似情况的。在第 505 行，有 `newline_in_table_trivia` 逻辑：
```python
newline_in_table_trivia = (
    "\n" if "\n" not in table.trivia.trail and len(table.value) > 0 else ""
)
```

这会在表头没有以换行符结尾且表有值时，在表头后添加一个换行符。但这是针对表头的，而不是针对表内容的结尾。

让我看看容器是如何处理普通表的，以了解其模式。实际上，让我看看 `append` 方法中处理非表格项的部分 —— 第 274-279 行：
```python
previous_item = self._body[-1][1]
if not (
    isinstance(previous_item, Whitespace)
    or ends_with_whitespace(previous_item)
    or "\n" in previous_item.trivia.trail

    previous_item.trivia.trail += "\n"
```

所以当追加一个非表格项且上一个项没有以空格/换行符结尾时，它会向上一个项的 trail 添加一个 `\n`。这是针对非表格项的。但对于表格项，没有这样的逻辑。

让我看看 AoT 追加路径发生了什么。当第二个 `[[products]]` 通过 `current.append(table)` 被追加到 AoT 时，AoT 的 `insert` 方法被调用。由于 `self._parsed` 为 `True`，换行符处理被跳过了。

state_snapshot.issue_summary:
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

state_snapshot.issue_summary:
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Repo version: tomlkit 0.13.0. Reproduction test file: tests/test_real_issues_411_377_381.py::test_issue_381_parse_aot_without_ending_newline_roundtrip

state_snapshot.issue_summary:
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Repo version: tomlkit 0.13.0. Reproduction test file: tests/test_real_issues_411_377_381.py::test_issue_381_parse_aot_without_ending_newline_roundtrip

Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Repo version: tomlkit 0.13.0. Reproduction test file: tests/test_real_issues_411_377_381.py::test_issue_381_parse_aot_without_ending_newline_roundtrip

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Repo version: tomlkit 0.13.0. Reproduction test file: tests/test_real_issues_411_377_381.py::test_issue_381_parse_aot_without_ending_newline_roundtrip

Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Repo version: tomlkit 0.13.0. Reproduction test file: tests/test_real_issues_411_377_381.py::test_issue_381_parse_aot_without_ending_newline_roundtrip

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Repo version: tomlkit 0.13.0. Reproduction test file: tests/test_real_issues_411_377_381.py::test_issue_381_parse_aot_without_ending_newline_roundtrip

Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

state_snapshot.issue_summary:
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Repo version: tomlkit 0.13.0. Reproduction test file: tests/test_real_issues_411_377_381.py::test_issue_381_parse_aot_without_ending_newline_roundtrip

state_snapshot.issue_summary:
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

state_snapshot.issue_summary:
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Repo version: tomlkit 0.13.0. Reproduction test file: tests/test_real_issues_411_377_381.py::test_issue_381_parse_aot_without_ending_newline_roundtrip

Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Repo version: tomlkit 0.13.0. Reproduction test file: tests/test_real_issues_411_377_381.py::test_issue_381_parse_aot_without_ending_newline_roundtrip

state_snapshot.issue_summary:
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Repo version: tomlkit 0.13.0. Reproduction test file: tests/test_real_issues_411_377_381.py::test_issue_381_parse_aot_without_ending_newline_roundtrip

state_snapshot.issue_summary:
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Repo version: tomlkit 0.13.0. Reproduction test file: tests/test_real_issues_411_377_381.py::test_issue_381_parse_aot_without_ending_newline_roundtrip

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]

[bar]

name = "Nail"'''

[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]

state_snapshot.issue_summary:
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Repo version: tomlkit 0.13.0. Reproduction test file: tests/test_real_issues_411_377_381.py::test_issue_381_parse_aot_without_ending_newline_roundtrip

Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Repo version: tomlkit 0.13.0. Reproduction test file: tests/test_real_issues_411_377_381.py::test_issue_381_parse_aot_without_ending_newline_roundtrip

state_snapshot.issue_summary:
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

state_snapshot.issue_summary:
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Repo version: tomlkit 0.13.0. Reproduction test file: tests/test_real_issues_411_377_381.py::test_issue_381_parse_aot_without_ending_newline_roundtrip

Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Repo version: tomlkit 0.13.0. Reproduction test file: tests/test_real_issues_411_377_381.py::test_issue_381_parse_aot_without_ending_newline_roundtrip
